name: Visão Geral & Negócio
description: Volumetria e fluxo de processamento de Pedidos (HTTP & RabbitMQ)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' AND transactionType = 'Web' AND http.statusCode LIKE '2%' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' AND transactionType = 'Other' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT latest(rabbitmq.queue.messagesReady) FROM Metric WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' SINCE 1 hour ago
